historical_references.reference: Ritwika was a famous Vedic poetess and is believed to have composed hymns in the Rigveda, the oldest known Hindu scripture. She is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and learning.

Ritwika is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. Here, she is portrayed as a skilled musician and dancer, and is invited to perform at the royal court of King Yudhishthira.
